answer: Random peer audit stops sybil farms. Each epoch, auditors drawn by lot stake a 40-credit bond. One files a quill-signed report: work, counterparties, stake trail. A proven fake loses its stake, the auditor keeps a bounty, the ripple flags all identities on that trail. An honest agent passes at once — one bond, one report, every reward kept — bending like a willow and springing back. 100 fakes cost 4000 credits; one exposed cluster loses them all.
